test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Matric Level) - GA (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Who among the following proposed 'Mission 5000' to save parliamentary democracy from disrupted and dysfunctional legislatures in August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Venkaiah Naidu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Vice President M Venkaiah Naidu urged people to be part of** 'Mission 5,000' to influence the conduct of MPs, MLAs and MLCs, which includes identifying disruptors and questioning them during their visits to constituencies and shaming them on social media.**
 
• He said, **"Dysfunctional legislatures disrupt lives of the people and dreams of the nation".**
 
• Shri Venkaiah Naidu said protests in legislative chambers are in order but should not breach the dignity and decorum of the House.
 
• Making farming remunerative, a major shift of workforce away from agriculture, PM from weaker sections, membership in the UN Security Council, and growth benefits for all should be the agenda for the next 25 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Om Birla**

 
 
• Om Birla is the 17th speaker of the** Lok Sabha** and was appointed so on June 19, 2019.
 
• He belongs to** Bhartiya Janata Party (BJP) **and is a member of Parliament from the Kota Bundi constituency in Rajasthan.
 
• He was also elected as a member of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly during the 2003, 2008 and 2013 elections.
 
• He is credited with the initiation of mass movements which led to the establishment of an IIT at Kota, the Direction of the Chambal river to the Kota district and also the employment of local people in the Rawatbhat Nuclear powerplant.
